title: GenAI evaluate aggregate logged-model metrics must carry the managed dataset name and digest
answers: mlflow.genai.evaluate model metrics show no dataset name or digest
logged model metrics not linked to evaluation dataset when using model_id
dataset_digest is null on metrics from genai evaluate
GenAI evaluation metrics missing dataset association
body:
Symptom: When a user runs mlflow.genai.evaluate with a managed EvaluationDataset and model_id, the candidate model's aggregate metrics (e.g. is_correct/mean) appear without the dataset they were computed on, so dataset_name and dataset_digest are null.
Root cause: mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run called mlflow.log_metrics(aggregated_metrics) without a dataset argument, so the dataset association was dropped even though _run_harness in mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py had the dataset.
Fix pattern: Thread the dataset object from the caller down to the aggregate metric logging call: add a dataset parameter to harness run(), pass it from _run_harness, and forward it as mlflow.log_metrics(aggregated_metrics, dataset=dataset).
Constraints: Only an explicitly supplied managed EvaluationDataset should be passed; plain list/DataFrame inputs keep dataset=None and unchanged metric logging. Keep the dataset argument out of per-row logging paths unless they need the same association.
applies: Aggregate metric logging inside the GenAI evaluation harness (mlflow/genai/evaluation), when model_id is provided.
says: The candidate model summary metrics are missing the evaluation dataset name and version.
Link aggregate evaluation scores back to the managed dataset they were computed against.
Overall model evaluation metrics show blank dataset information in the evaluation results view.
Benchmark scores for the evaluated model are not tagged with the test dataset.
Show which evaluation dataset generated the aggregate accuracy metrics on the model report.
search: Aggregate metric logging in the GenAI evaluation harness must forward explicitly supplied managed EvaluationDataset objects to mlflow.log_metrics so logged candidate model metrics retain their dataset association. In mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness and mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py:run, thread the dataset parameter into mlflow.log_metrics(aggregated_metrics, dataset=dataset) when model_id is provided. Plain list or DataFrame inputs must retain dataset=None, and the dataset argument should not be added to per-row logging paths.
